{{Top|leg}}
'''Platform 3107''' was a landing platform on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was near to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] once landed their ship there as part of the operation to bring the [[Pulas]] from [[Almas]] to Coruscant. They were met there by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Devan For'deschel]] and asked her a few questions before they all left in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].
